# std.records

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Typed record operations.

## Types

### `Extends`

```badger
protocol Extends {  }
```

`S: Extends<T>`: every field of record `T` is present in `S` at the same
type. Solved structurally by the compiler.

### `Projects`

```badger
protocol Projects {  }
```

`S: Projects<T>`: `S` has every field of `T` at the same type, so the
closed subset `T` can be projected out. Solved by the compiler.

## Functions

### `field_count`

```badger
fn field_count
```

The number of fields of the record behind `value` (a compile-time
constant).

### `merge`

```badger
fn merge
```

Right-biased merge: overlapping fields take the right value and type.

### `merge_left`

```badger
fn merge_left
```

Left-biased merge: overlapping fields take the left value and type.

### `omit`

```badger
fn omit
```

The record without the fields in a literal label list, in one copy

### `project`

```badger
fn project
```

Construct the closed subset `T` of a record value (copies fields).

```badger
fn remove
```

### `rename`


The record with field `from` renamed to `to` (both literal labels; `from`
